title: 20 Minutes Downtown Austin and Lake Austin
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The remaining time will be spent on our preflight safety briefing and orientation.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the vibrant heart of Austin from above with our 20-minute Downtown Austin and Lake Austin Tour. You'll fly over key landmarks like UT Stadium, the Texas State Capitol, and Frost Bank Tower, capturing the essence of the city's skyline. Soar over the serene waters of Lake Austin. This tour is perfect for adventure seekers, families, and anyone wanting a quick yet comprehensive aerial view of Austin's urban and natural beauty. Join us for an unforgettable journey that showcases the best of Austin in just 20 minutes. This tour is not wheelchair accessible.
